portal.subtitle: Unified management of providers, quota, and download tasks

providers.title: Providers
providers.empty: No providers yet. Click the button above to register one.
providers.name_exists: A provider with this name already exists

provider_form.name: Name *
provider_form.local_path_hint: Uses GetDiskFreeSpaceEx to read the real total, used, and available capacity of the disk containing this path.
provider_form.baidu_token_hint: How to get: Verify your Baidu cloud login and fill in the corresponding Key to obtain the token.
provider_form.quark_cookie_hint: How to get: Open pan.quark.cn → F12 → Network → click any request → find Cookie in request headers → right-click copy value. The cookie must contain __pus and __t fields.
provider_form.account_id_hint: Helps distinguish multiple accounts of the same type. Can be left blank.
provider_form.baidu_notice: After registration, create a Mount → sync quota. The BaiduProvider will use your access_token to fetch real capacity data from the Baidu API.
provider_form.quark_notice: After registration, create a Mount → sync quota. The QuarkProvider will use your cookie to fetch real capacity data from the Quark API. Direct download is not supported.
provider_form.local_notice: After registration, create a Mount → sync quota. The LocalWindowsProvider will read the real disk capacity of the specified path.
provider_form.generic_notice: After registration, create a Mount, then sync quota on the Quota page. Generic mode shows test data.

options.generic_desc: Routes all operations through the OpenList API. Works with any drive configured in OpenList.
options.baidu_desc: Dedicated Baidu backend with direct download support. Requires a Baidu access token.
options.quark_desc: Dedicated Quark backend with quota sync support. Requires a Quark cookie.
options.local_desc: Reads real disk capacity from the local filesystem. Requires a drive path.

quota.title: Quota Management
quota.description: Query and sync drive quota through Mount points
quota.mount_created: Mount created successfully, click Sync Quota to get data
quota.inherit_no_parents: No real-mode mounts available. Create a mount in 'real' mode first.
quota.empty_no_provider: Register a provider on the Providers page first
quota.empty_no_data: No quota data yet. Click "Query Quota" or "Sync Quota"
quota.no_mounts: No mounts for this provider. Click "Create Mount" to add one.
quota.delete_confirm_message: Are you sure you want to delete this mount? This action cannot be undone.
quota.mount_path_hint: This must be a real path that already exists in OpenList / WebDAV, not an auto-generated placeholder path.
quota.mount_path_required: Please enter a valid OpenList path

tasks.title: Download Tasks
tasks.empty_no_tasks: No download tasks yet. Create one above or from the file browser.
tasks.empty_no_match: No tasks match the current filter.
tasks.open_file_failed: Failed to open file on computer
tasks.open_file_location_failed: Failed to show file location on computer

download_dialog.dir_placeholder: Leave empty for default download directory
download_dialog.computer_note_folder: Folder downloads are submitted to the computer that hosts OpenBridge / aria2, not to the phone or tablet you are using now.
download_dialog.computer_note_folder_baidu: Baidu folders can first be resolved into a direct-link manifest and then sent to another device for self-download. If you submit to aria2, the tasks still run on the computer hosting OpenBridge / aria2.
download_dialog.computer_note_file: If you submit a single file to aria2, it will download on the computer that hosts OpenBridge / aria2. You can also use “Download to This Device” to download it on the device you are using now.
download_dialog.mobile_file_note: Single files can be downloaded directly to the current phone or tablet. If you submit them to aria2, they will still download on the computer that hosts OpenBridge / aria2.
download_dialog.terminal_direct_mode: This file already has a non-OpenList proxied direct link, so it is ready for terminal-side download, link copy, or QR transfer.
download_dialog.scanning_folder: Scanning folder and preparing its tree structure...
download_dialog.folder_empty: This folder does not contain downloadable files
download_dialog.folder_structure_hint: The download keeps the original tree structure and will be placed under the “{name}” folder inside the target directory.
download_dialog.folder_requires_dir: Folder download needs a download directory so the full folder structure can be preserved.
download_dialog.direct_actions_hint: A terminal-usable direct download URL is already available for this file, so it does not need OpenBridge server-side relay.
download_dialog.qr_privacy_note: The QR image is currently generated by an external QR service. Only use it in an environment you trust.
download_dialog.folder_manifest_hint: Best for Baidu folders. Each file will be resolved into a direct link, then bundled into a manifest you can copy or download for use on another device.
download_dialog.manifest_failed: Failed to generate the direct-link manifest.
download_dialog.folder_zip_hint: Non-Baidu folders can be downloaded directly to the current device as a ZIP file without extra rclone steps.

settings.title: Settings
settings.rclone_path_hint: Set the rclone executable path, for example C:\Program Files\rclone\rclone.exe. It will be written into .env.
settings.dir_hint: Leave empty to use aria2's configured default. Changes apply to new downloads.
settings.session_timeout_hint: Stored only in this browser on this device. Re-login is required after timeout, backend restart, OpenList source changes, or OpenList auth loss.
settings.reset_desc: You can reset only the current OpenList source or wipe the entire database. This action cannot be undone.
settings.reset_current_desc: Only clear providers, mounts, quota snapshots, and newly scoped download tasks for the current OpenList Base URL.
settings.reset_current_confirm: Are you sure you want to reset data for the current OpenList source? This deletes providers, mounts, quota records, and matching download tasks for the current source.
settings.reset_current_success: Data for the current OpenList source has been cleared
settings.reset_all_desc: Truly wipe all providers, mounts, quota snapshots, and download tasks from the database across every OpenList source.
settings.reset_all_confirm: Are you sure you want to reset all data? This permanently deletes all providers, mounts, quota records, and download tasks in the database.
settings.reset_confirm: Are you sure you want to reset all user data? This will permanently delete all providers, mounts, tasks, and quota records.
settings.reset_success: All user data has been cleared
settings.user_info_desc: Current logged-in user profile from OpenList

rclone.title: Rclone Profiles
rclone.description: Save, preview, and execute local rclone mount profiles
rclone.empty: No rclone profiles yet. Add one first.
rclone.password_hint: The password is stored in a reversible obscured form in the local database. Leave it empty to keep the saved password unchanged.
rclone.password_required: Password is required when creating a new profile.
rclone.target_path_hint: On Windows, this can be a drive letter or directory, for example X: or C:\mnt\ob.
rclone.mount_select_hint: Select one mount for ordinary mode; select at least two for Union / Combine.
rclone.mode_hint_ordinary: One mount maps to one rclone WebDAV remote.
rclone.mode_hint_union: Multiple mounts are merged into one Union remote.
rclone.mode_hint_combine: Multiple mounts are exposed as subdirectories in one Combine remote.
rclone.no_mounts: No mounts are available yet. Create mounts from the quota page first.
rclone.path_missing: Set the rclone path in Settings first, or make sure rclone is available from PATH.
